t: A free 15-hour online course on AI basics and ethics for high school students.
steps: Find the AI Foundations course on IBM SkillsBuild.
Sign up for a free IBM SkillsBuild account as a high school student or an educator.
Check the age rules. The program is for ages 13 to 18.
Ask the organization to register a whole class through the bulk form.
Set a pace of about 15 hours across the term.
Plan time for the AI Design Challenge.
Prepare students for the final assessment and its 80 percent badge score.
